title: 第11章 她有点失望第12章 开脉大典
slug: 真心待你反被弃转娶圣女你悔啥
lines: read2（）;后不后悔辰南不知道，但此时他的心情却是很好。
“我已经达到了气血境十重，若是炼化了这百万灵石，说不定我能够开辟丹田，突破到轮海境！”
还有两天就是开脉大典。
这是辰南第一次登台亮相，也是第一次以家主的身份展现在世人面前。
若是表现欠佳，丢的不仅仅是自己的面子，更是辰家一脉的脸面。
气血境十重再强，也只是气血境。
一个气血境的家主，未免有些不够看。
因此辰南想要抓住这两天的时间，突破到轮海境。
虽然轮海境的家主依旧很弱，但起码撑得住场面。
念及于此，辰南便是对李青山吩咐了一声，便再次进入天辰殿内闭关。
开脉大典虽然繁杂，但李青山的能力很强，方方面面都打理得井井有条。
姜玉婵送来的这个管家，让辰南很是满意，可以安心的当个甩手掌柜。
而在辰南闭关之时，林轻眉带着林子衿返回了玉灵峰。
“姐，你一定要替我报仇啊！”
“那个姓辰的实在太嚣张，太狂妄了。”
“我只不过是去找他理论，他便让人打了我一巴掌，还抢走了我的宝物，逼我下跪。”
“这口气我咽不下去，早晚要让他连本带利的还回来！”
林子衿咬牙切齿，双眸喷火，对辰南恨到了骨子里。
“你为什么擅自去紫阳峰？”
林轻眉盯着林子衿，面无表情的问道。
“我这不是听说药长老不给母亲治病，一时气急，所以去找姓辰的理论！”
林子衿不敢去看姐姐的眼睛。
“告诉我，你是怎么突破轮海境的？”
林轻眉眼神犀利，让林子衿头皮发麻。
“我卡在气血境九重很久了，前几天修炼，不知不觉就突破了轮海境。”
林子衿的声音低弱。
“说实话！”
林轻眉的语气加重了几分。
林子衿从小到大，最怕的便是姐姐。

read2(); Chen Nan didn't know that he didn't regret it later, but he was in a very good mood at this time.
"I have reached the tenth level of Qi and Blood Realm. If I refine these million spirit stones, maybe I can open up my Dantian and break through to the Wheel Sea Realm!"
There are only two days until the pulse opening ceremony.
This is the first time Chen Nan has appeared on stage, and it is also the first time he has appeared in front of the world as the head of the family.
If you perform poorly, you will not only lose your own face, but also the face of the Chen family.
No matter how strong the tenth level of Qi and Blood Realm is, it is still only in the Qi and Blood Realm.
A family head in the Qi and Blood Realm is a bit unsatisfied.
Therefore, Chen Nan wanted to seize these two days to break through to the Wheel Sea Realm.
Although the family leader in the Wheel Sea Realm is still very weak, he can at least hold on to the situation.
Thinking of this, Chen Nan gave instructions to Li Qingshan and entered the Tianchen Hall for retreat again.
Although the pulse opening ceremony was complicated, Li Qingshan was very capable and took care of all aspects in an orderly manner.
The butler sent by Jiang Yuchan made Chen Nan very satisfied, and he could be a hands-off shopkeeper with peace of mind.
While Chen Nan was in retreat, Lin Qingmei took Lin Zijin back to Yuling Peak.
"Sister, you must avenge me!"
"That person named Chen is really too arrogant and arrogant."
"I just went to him to argue, but he slapped me in the face, took away my treasures, and forced me to kneel down."
"I can't swallow this breath. Sooner or later, I will have to pay him back with interest!"
Lin Zijin gritted his teeth, his eyes burst into flames, and he hated Chen Nan to his core.
"Why did you go to Ziyang Peak without permission?"
Lin Qingmei stared at Lin Zijin and asked expressionlessly.
"Ah!"
"I heard that Elder Yao refused to treat my mother's illness, so I got angry for a moment, so I went to find Chen's theory!"
Lin Zijin didn't dare to look into his sister's eyes.
"Tell me, how did you break through the Wheel Sea Realm?"
Lin Qingmei's sharp eyes made Lin Zijin's scalp tingle.
"I've been stuck at the ninth level of the Qi and Blood Realm for a long time. I practiced a few days ago and unknowingly broke through to the Wheel and Sea Realm."
Lin Zijin's voice was low.
"Tell the truth!"
Lin Qingmei's tone became a little more serious.
Ever since he was little, Lin Zijin has been most afraid of his sister.
